The [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic's]] '''Supply Fleet''' was assigned to [[Support Services/Legends|Support Services]], and was responsible for transporting supplies to bases and [[Fleet/Legends|fleets]] across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. The Supply Fleet operated a number of [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|YT-1300 light freighters]], [[GR-75 medium transport/Legends|GR-75 medium transports]], and [[Action VI bulk transport/Legends|Action VI transports]].
